description: Faults injected by the portable runtime (CROSSTL_COMPUTESHARP_FAULT) and the upstream test methods that must fail under each fault. Every discovered case of every listed method must execute and fail; a pass, a skip or a missing case fails the control. The same cases must pass in the unfaulted run.

controls.purpose: Dispatches are recorded in the evidence but never reach the device, so outputs keep their initial contents.
The first two resources of the same kind and format exchange their target slots.
The first user constant (or the dispatch width when there is none) changes before the dispatch.
The first byte of every buffer and texture readback is altered on the host.
After each dispatch the device writes four bytes just past the visible region of the first writable buffer, as an out-of-bounds store would.
